data_fields.name: ammo_carry_cap
data_fields.donor_constant: rule: add = min(count, MaxCarry - held); MaxCarry cvar-driven or fixed per ammo type (values not read)

data_fields.name: duplicate_pickup_rule
data_fields.donor_constant: rule: take what fits, subtract from pickup, remove pickup only when 0 left

data_fields.name: default_clip_on_pickup
data_fields.donor_constant: rule: GetDefaultClip1 per gun script (values not read); overflow above max clip goes to reserve

best_idea: A duplicate loot pickup converts into the owned item's ammo up to the carry cap, the drop keeps the leftover, and the drop is removed only at zero.
decision_why: Duplicates-as-ammo and leftover-stays fit loot drops in a many-on-one fight; the slot swap must check the pickup's own slot and replace the empty gun, not stack it.
acceptance: Server test: a gun holds 18 of 30 rounds; a duplicate drop with 20 rounds gives the bag +12, leaves 8 on the ground, and the drop is removed only when it reaches 0.
